title: Drive end states and exit codes

name.description: The state's name as a drive-status.ts --json report's state field carries it, or the name of a class of states, a withdrawn code or an exit with no report.

kind.description: state, class-label, tombstone, driver-only or helper, as the code names its categories.

exit.description: The code this entry holds in the drive's numbering.

driveStatusExit.description: The code drive-status.ts exits with for it; null when drive-status.ts never does.

driveExit.description: The code drive.ts ends with for it; null when drive.ts never does.

endsDrive.description: Whether it ends the drive without the caller re-arming it on its own; null for a withdrawn code.

meaning.description: What it means to a reader that branches on it, and what that reader does next.

values.name: ROUND_READY
values.meaning: Work is left for this round: open review threads or unanswered summary findings. The caller runs a pass; `drive.ts` runs it itself and never ends with this state.

values.name: INDETERMINATE
values.meaning: The state could not be read, or a step failed: `drive.ts` also ends with it when a pass fails. Never a settled state; read what the drive printed before re-arming.

values.name: UNSUPPORTED_CLI
values.meaning: A prerequisite is missing: the installed `gh` cannot report a field the round needs. `drive.ts` also exits `2`, with no report, when it refuses to start: a command line it cannot use, or a working tree or pull request it cannot drive as they stand (uncommitted changes, commits the pull request does not have, a head in a fork). It prints which.

values.name: CONVERGED
values.meaning: The pull request is ready to merge: the reviewer reviewed this exact head and nothing is left open. `drive.ts` exits `0` for it, once its own working tree is clean.

values.name: HEAD_LAG
values.meaning: The pull request's head on the forge and the local head disagree, and the reason says how: a local head ahead with no record of a push (push it through `guarded-push.ts`), a push the forge does not show yet (wait), a tree behind (update it), or diverged history (reconcile it). Then read again.

values.name: AWAITING_REVIEWER
values.meaning: The reviewer has not reviewed this head yet. Wait, then read again.

values.name: STALE_REVIEW
values.meaning: The reviewer's latest review describes an earlier head. Wait for its review of this one, then read again.

values.name: HEAD_MOVED
values.meaning: The head or the base moved while the round was being judged, so nothing read about it holds. Read again.

values.name: MERGEABILITY_UNKNOWN
values.meaning: The forge has not yet worked out whether the pull request merges cleanly. Read again.

values.name: NOT_SETTLED
values.meaning: The name of every state that shares exit `4`: the pull request is not ready to judge yet. Never itself a `state`; the caller waits and runs the drive again. `drive.ts` also exits `4` after the review converged when another driver holds the mark-Ready lease, when the head moved or the CI hold label changed as the hold was released, when no fresh result of a required check came in time (where a skipped or cancelled check means waiting cannot help: re-run the check, then re-arm), and when the drive keeps a draft that the reviewer skips (mark it Ready, then re-arm).

values.name: PR_NOT_OPEN
values.meaning: The pull request was merged or closed. Stop, and push nothing to it.

values.name: MAX_ROUNDS
values.meaning: The drive spent its round budget (`--max-rounds`) without converging. Read the handoff file before re-arming.

values.name: REVIEWER_FAILED
values.meaning: The reviewer's own check did not pass, so the absence of findings proves nothing. A person looks at the reviewer before re-arming.

values.name: HITL_PARKED
values.meaning: Everything left waits on a person's decision, each framed on its thread. The drive does not wake itself: once every one is answered, re-arm it.

values.name: PR_CONFLICTING
values.meaning: The pull request conflicts with its base and has nothing else to work on; `drive.ts` ends with it once its conflict-repair passes are spent. Merge the base in, then re-arm.

values.name: RETIRED
values.meaning: Withdrawn: it once stopped a drive on a draft pull request, which is now driven like any other. Never exited, and never given another meaning.

values.name: SESSION_LEASE_HELD
values.meaning: Another live session in this working tree holds the drive's lease for this pull request. Nothing was changed: wait for it, or clear its lease once its process is gone.

values.name: SINGLE_INSTANCE_LOCK
values.meaning: Another driver already holds this pull request's or this working tree's lock, so the drive is already armed. Nothing was changed.

values.name: WORKTREE_UNCLEAN
values.meaning: The working tree holds work no round shipped: uncommitted edits, an unfinished git operation or a commit nobody reviewed. Settle it, then re-arm in this tree.

values.name: DRIVE_HELD_BY_OTHER_WORKTREE
values.meaning: Another live working tree, or a driver in another clone, is driving this pull request. Nothing was changed; that driver is the one to finish.

values.name: STALLED
values.meaning: Rounds stopped changing anything the drive can see. Read what the passes decided, and what the tree still holds, before re-arming.

values.name: PASS_DEADLINE
values.meaning: A pass ran past its deadline and was stopped more often than the drive restarts one. Check the tree for the stopped pass's leftovers before re-arming.

values.name: QUOTA_PARKED
values.meaning: A pass hit an agent subscription's usage limit that does not reset soon. Re-arm after the reset, or from a session that bills another account. `drive.ts` also exits `16` when it refuses such a re-arm while the limit holds, from a session that bills the same account or one it cannot tell.

values.name: PUSH_HELD
values.meaning: A `hold-push` directive in the drive's mailbox is in force, so nothing was pushed; the pre-push hook's recheck exits with it to stop a push already under way. Not an end state: clear the hold, then push again.

values.name: MAILBOX_STOPPED
values.meaning: A person or a tool told the drive to stop through its mailbox, and it stopped at a round boundary. A stop that names this driver's generation ends this driver alone; one that names none stops every later driver too, so resume it before re-arming.

values.name: MAILBOX_PAUSE_TIMEOUT
values.meaning: A pause sent through the drive's mailbox lasted longer than the drive waits. Resume it, then re-arm.

values.name: TAKEN_OVER
values.meaning: Another clone took the drive over and drives it now. Nothing to recover here.

values.name: CI_REPAIR_SPENT
values.meaning: The review converged, but required checks still fail after the drive's CI-repair passes were spent. A re-armed drive repairs again.

values.name: REVIEW_SKIPPED
values.meaning: The reviewer skipped this head and its review of an earlier head does not cover it, so no review will come. A person has this head reviewed, then re-arms.

values.name: CI_INFRA_PERSISTED
values.meaning: The review converged, but checks kept failing on the CI service's own infrastructure after the drive re-ran them. Nothing in the code needs repair; re-arm once the service recovers.
